name: @quarry/catalog-microservice
description: The Catalog service (docs/design/architecture-split.md): datasets, their storage and DuckDB, in a process of its own, on its own database login. The platform is @quarry/platform-server, in-process; browsers reach it through the main server.

scripts.dev: nodemon -w src -w ../../../platform/kernel -w ../../../libraries/shared -w ../../../libraries/integrations -e ts,json --exec ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/main.ts
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
